notes: One CGLS update; deterministic synthetic observations. Times include harness and Metal process/serialization overhead. MLX retains its warmed operator and background cache. Memory is MiB. Child ru_maxrss is a cumulative high-water mark, so its delta can be zero even when the child uses memory. Relative difference is the maximum across outputs of max absolute error divided by each reference output's maximum magnitude.
